enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping restlessly with the fan on low; brief wakeful periods typical of poor sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed on the right side. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Turn over onto the left side. Reach out with the right hand and press the fan switch to low. Turn onto the back. Open eyes. Close eyes. Turn onto the right side. Push the pillow with the hand. Kick the blanket off one leg. Pull the blanket back over the leg. Turn onto the left side. Grip the edge of the mattress. Sit up briefly. Lie back down on the back. Reach out and turn the fan head with the hand. Pull the blanket up to the chin. Turn onto the right side. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing face, brushing teeth and showering with hot water; steady, unhurried morning routine (Bathroom free after Member 1 finishes at 06:25)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the tap. Rinse both hands. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Spit into the sink. Rinse the mouth with tap water. Put the toothbrush back in the holder. Turn on the water heater. Step into the shower. Turn on the shower tap. Wet the body. Apply soap to the arms and legs. Wash the body. Rinse the soap off. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the hair. Dry the body. Wrap the towel. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in school uniform and checking the school bag and planner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Open the wardrobe door. Take out the school shirt. Take out the trousers. Close the wardrobe door. Put on the shirt. Button the shirt. Put on the trousers. Fasten the waistband. Open the school bag. Take out the planner. Open the planner. Read the timetable page. Close the planner. Put the planner back into the bag. Zip the school bag closed.

enriched_activities.activity: Toasting bread and boiling the kettle; refilling the cat's food and water bowls (Kitchen free after Member 1 leaves at 07:00)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Take two slices of bread from the bread bag. Place the bread in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Fill the kettle with water at the tap. Place the kettle on its base. Press the kettle switch on. Open the cupboard door. Take out the cat food tin. Open the tin with the tin opener. Spoon the food into the cat bowl. Place the cat bowl on the floor. Pick up the cat water bowl. Fill the bowl at the tap. Place the water bowl on the floor. Take the toasted bread out of the toaster. Place the bread on a plate. Pour hot water from the kettle into a mug. Turn off the kettle.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast quietly while taking the daily chronic-condition medication
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the dining room. Turn on the light. Place the plate and the mug on the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the bread. Eat the bread. Pick up the mug. Drink the water. Open the medication box. Take out the daily tablet. Place the tablet on the tongue. Swallow the tablet with water. Close the medication box. Pick up the plate. Pick up the mug. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up breakfast dishes and packing a lunch and water bottle; clearing the Kitchen before Member 2 uses it at 08:05
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Place the plate in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the plate with the sponge. Rinse the plate again. Place the plate on the drying rack. Place the mug on the drying rack. Take the lunch box from the cupboard. Place the lunch box on the counter. Put the sandwiches into the lunch box. Close the lunch box lid. Fill the water bottle at the tap. Place the water bottle and the lunch box into the school bag. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light. Walk out of the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to secondary school by public transport, pacing carefully due to mild mobility limitation (no EV needed; Member 2 drives the EV alone at 08:35)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the front door. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door behind. Pull the school bag onto both shoulders. Walk down the path at a slow pace. Stop at the kerb. Press the pedestrian button. Wait for the green light. Cross the road. Walk to the bus stop. Stop and wait. Take the phone from the pocket. Check the bus arrival time on the screen. Put the phone back into the pocket. Step onto the bus. Tap the card on the reader. Walk down the aisle. Hold the handrail. Stand near the door. Step off the bus. Walk to the school gate at a slow pace.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending full-day secondary school classes, taking notes and completing set work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the classroom. Sit at the desk. Open the school bag. Take out the notebook and pencil case. Open the notebook. Write notes during the lesson. Take out the textbook. Turn to the set page. Complete the exercises on the page. Raise the hand. Answer the teacher's question. Close the textbook. Put the textbook into the bag. Stand up and move to the next classroom. Sit at a new desk. Write the next set of notes. Open the lunch box. Eat the lunch. Close the lunch box. Put the lunch box into the bag. Stand up. Walk out of the classroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the nearby grandparent's house for after-school caregiving duties
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the school gate. Walk along the pavement at a slow pace. Stop at the crossing. Wait for the pedestrian light. Cross the road. Continue walking along the pavement. Stop at the next kerb. Cross the side street. Walk past the shops. Reach the grandparent's gate. Push the gate open. Walk up the path. Stop at the front door. Knock on the door. Open the door. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Caring for grandparent: preparing a light afternoon meal, sorting medication, tidying and keeping company
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator. Take out the vegetables. Place them on the counter. Wash the vegetables at the tap. Pick up the knife. Chop the vegetables on the board. Place the pot on the stove. Turn on the stove. Add water to the pot. Put the vegetables into the pot. Stir the soup with the spoon. Turn off the stove. Pour the soup into a bowl. Carry the bowl to the table. Help the grandparent to the chair. Sit down next to the grandparent. Open the medication box. Take out the pills. Sort the pills into the weekly pill organiser. Fill the water glass. Hand the glass to the grandparent. Pick up the empty plates. Carry the plates to the sink. Wipe the table with the cloth. Walk to the living room with the grandparent. Sit on the sofa next to the grandparent. Turn on the television. Talk with the grandparent and answer questions about school. Stand up. Pick up the school bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking home from grandparent's house
enriched_activities.desc: Say goodbye to the grandparent at the door. Walk to the front door. Open the door. Step outside. Close the door. Walk down the path at a slow pace. Push the gate open. Step onto the pavement. Turn right. Walk along the main road. Stop at the crossing. Wait for the green light. Cross the road. Continue on the pavement. Walk up to the house. Open the front door. Step inside. Close the door.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking the school bag, changing into home clothes and greeting the cat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Place the school bag on the chair. Open the zip. Take out the lunch box. Take out the planner. Place the lunch box and the planner on the desk. Take off the school shirt. Take off the trousers. Put on the home t-shirt. Put on the home trousers. Walk to the cat. Bend down. Stroke the cat's head. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member 1 and Member 2, using the induction cooker and rice cooker, preparing a meal compatible with everyone's dietary needs
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and the eggs. Place them on the counter. Close the refrigerator door. Wash the vegetables at the tap. Chop the vegetables on the board. Turn on the induction cooker. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Stir with the spatula. Open the rice cooker lid. Spoon the rice into the bowls. Replace the rice cooker lid. Turn off the induction cooker. Hand the plates to Member 1 and Member 2. Answer Member 1's question about the grandparent.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table with Member 1 and Member 2, air conditioner on, phone face-down for a calm meal
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the bowls to the dining room. Place the bowls on the table. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Pick up the remote. Press the air conditioner on. Place the remote on the table. Take the phone from the pocket. Place the phone face-down on the table. Pick up the chopsticks. Eat the rice. Eat the vegetables. Pick up the bowl. Drink the soup. Place the bowl down. Talk with Member 1 and Member 2 about the school day. Answer Member 2's question about homework. Pick up the last of the rice. Place the chopsticks down. Stand up. Pick up the bowls.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes with Member 1 and Member 2, wiping the counters and storing leftovers
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the bowls into the kitchen. Place the bowls in the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the bowls. Pick up the sponge. Wipe the bowls with the sponge. Rinse the bowls again. Place the bowls on the drying rack. Hand the glasses to Member 2. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the counter. Open the refrigerator door. Place the leftovers into the container. Put the container into the refrigerator. Close the refrigerator door. Turn off the tap. Turn off the light.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting and running a load of washing, then hanging items to dry (Member 1 and Member 2 are out walking the dog)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the laundry. Turn on the light. Pick up the laundry basket. Sort the dark clothes from the light clothes. Open the washing machine door. Place the dark clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the start button. Wait next to the machine until the cycle ends. Open the washing machine door. Take out the wet clothes. Pick up a hanger. Hang the shirt on the hanger. Hang the shirt on the drying line. Hang the trousers on the line. Hang the towels on the line. Turn off the light. Walk out of the laundry.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting with Member 1 and Member 2 on the sofa, listening to music on the phone and sending one-on-one messages to a close friend
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit on the sofa next to Member 1. Take the phone from the pocket. Open the music app. Press play. Put the earphones in the ears. Open the message app. Tap the friend's chat. Type a message. Press send. Read the reply. Type a reply. Press send. Take the earphones out. Put the phone into the pocket. Stand up from the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Completing homework and structured study at the computer with the desk lamp on (Study free; Member 2 uses it later at 21:45)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the study. Pull out the chair. Sit down. Press the desk lamp switch on. Press the computer power button. Log in with the password. Open the school portal. Open the assignment file. Type the answers on the keyboard. Take out the notebook. Write the working with the pen. Open the textbook. Read the set chapter. Write notes in the notebook. Complete the worksheet. Save the file with the keyboard shortcut. Press the computer shut-down button. Press the desk lamp switch off. Stand up. Push the chair in. Walk out of the study.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book and listening to calm music to wind down and ease anxiety
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Sit on the bed. Pick up the book from the nightstand. Open the book. Read the page. Turn the page. Read the next page. Turn the page. Pick up the phone from the nightstand. Open the music app. Press play on the calm playlist. Place the phone on the nightstand. Close the book. Place the book on the nightstand.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing night-time hygiene routine before bed (Bathroom free until Member 2 at 22:45)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the light. Turn on the water heater. Step into the shower. Turn on the shower tap. Wet the body. Apply soap. Wash the body. Rinse the soap off. Turn off the shower tap. Pick up the towel. Dry the body. Dry the hair. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the bristles. Brush the teeth. Rinse the mouth. Hang the towel on the rail. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Lying in bed with the light off and the fan running, trying to fall asleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into Bedroom 3. Press the light switch off. Press the fan switch on. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket up over the body. Turn onto the right side. Adjust the pillow with the hand. Turn onto the left side. Turn onto the back. Reach out and turn the fan head with the hand. Pull the blanket up to the shoulder. Turn onto the right side. Turn onto the left side. Place the arm under the pillow. Turn onto the back. Close eyes.
